[[File:Mattberry_plant.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A mattberry plant on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].]]
'''Mattberries''' were fruits from the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] were known to squeeze the juice out of them to make juice. The juice could also be fermented to create a bitter-tasting alcoholic brew.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|294|mattberry}}</ref> Mattberries were produced by [[mattberry plant]].<ref name="SWG">''[[From Pencil to Pixel: The Art of Star Wars Galaxies]]''</ref>
